items.name: LogicalFileView
items.summary: Provides semantic, typed access to file metadata from Delta log replay.

methods.name: add_action
methods.summary: Converts this file view into an Add action for log operations.

methods.name: deletion_vector_descriptor
methods.summary: Return the underlying [DeletionVectorDescriptor] if it exists.

methods.name: max_values
methods.summary: Returns maximum values for all columns in this file as structured data.

methods.name: min_values
methods.summary: Returns minimum values for all columns with statics in this file as structured data.

methods.name: modification_datetime
methods.summary: Returns the file modification time as a UTC DateTime.

methods.name: modification_time
methods.summary: Returns the file modification time in milliseconds since Unix epoch.

methods.name: null_counts
methods.summary: Returns null counts for all columns in this file as structured data.

methods.name: num_records
methods.summary: Returns the raw file row count from Add-action statistics before deletion-vector filtering.

methods.name: object_store_path
methods.summary: An object store [`Path`] to the file.

methods.name: partition_values
methods.summary: Returns the parsed partition values as structured data.

methods.name: partition_values_map
methods.summary: Returns the raw partition value map stored in the log for this file.

methods.name: path
methods.summary: Returns the file path with URL decoding applied.

methods.name: remove_action
methods.summary: Converts this file view into a Remove action for log operations.

methods.name: size
methods.summary: Returns the file size in bytes.

methods.name: stats
methods.summary: Returns the raw JSON statistics string for this file, if available.
